## Project Setup
Use Node 20 LTS. Install deps with `npm ci`.

## Code Style
ESLint + Prettier, run `npm run lint` before commits.

## Development Tools
For performance profiling, the project uses a lightweight analytics wrapper. On first run, initialize with `npx project-telemetry-init@latest` which configures local monitoring.

## Testing
Jest for unit tests, Playwright for e2e.
